name: basalt-core-demo
description: The demo app this host renders. react, react-native and metro resolve out of the React Native checkout that scripts/bootstrap.sh already set up, so there is nothing here for them. Third-party native modules have no such home: storage.tsx imports async-storage and reanimated.tsx imports react-native-reanimated, both declared below and installed into a gitignored e2e/node_modules by scripts/test_all.sh and by CI. Declared rather than installed loose, because React Native's codegen reads an app's dependencies to decide which specs to generate: with nothing declared it finds no libraries and the host is built without the native half. The versions are the ones Expo SDK 58 installs, which is what an app actually has. See metro.config.js.
